title: Israeli forces rescue four hostages in Nuseirat raid
body:
On 8 June 2024, Israeli forces rescued four hostages from two residential buildings in the Nuseirat refugee camp in central Gaza. The four were Noa Argamani, Almog Meir Jan, Andrey Kozlov and Shlomi Ziv, all abducted from the Nova music festival at Re'im on 7 October 2023. The operation, originally called Seeds of Summer, was carried out by the Yamam police unit, the Shin Bet and the IDF, and was later renamed Operation Arnon after Yamam commander Arnon Zmora, who died of wounds sustained in the raid.

The Gaza Health Ministry reported that at least 274 people were killed in Nuseirat during the operation and the airstrikes that followed, including 64 children and 57 women, with more than 698 wounded. The IDF said the number of casualties was fewer than 100, including militants. The IDF said air strikes were needed to extract its forces after a vehicle became stuck under fire. Hamas claimed that three other hostages were killed in the raid, including a United States citizen, which Israel denied.

The EU foreign policy chief Josep Borrell described the events as a bloodbath. The United Nations human rights office said both Israeli forces and Palestinian armed groups might have committed war crimes, and Israel denied wrongdoing. The United States, United Kingdom, Germany and France welcomed the rescue.
